question: In the HPA CPTAC protein differential-expression data, compare Colon AC, Lung AC and Ovary SC. Use adjusted p<0.01 and absolute logFC>=0.5 as the differential-expression rule, with logFC>0 up and logFC<0 down. Establish the number of genes with finite logFC and adjusted p in all three cancers. Within that common universe report up/down counts per cancer and pairwise Jaccard similarities of the upregulated sets. Find genes differentially expressed in at least two cancers, with opposing signs among those significant changes. Report that set's size and select twelve genes with the largest range of logFC across cancers, breaking ties by Ensembl ID. Give their three logFCs and adjusted p-values, RNA cancer specificity and FDA approved drug-target status. Draw the direction-count bars, a Jaccard heatmap and a logFC heatmap, and provide their tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT c.Gene, c.Cancer, TRY_CAST(c.logFC AS DOUBLE) l, TRY_CAST(c.\"p-value adjusted\" AS DOUBLE) p FROM cancer_cptac c JOIN proteinatlas m ON c.Gene=m.Ensembl WHERE c.Cancer IN ('Colon AC','Lung AC','Ovary SC')), w AS (SELECT Gene, max(l) FILTER(Cancer='Colon AC') co_l, max(p) FILTER(Cancer='Colon AC') co_p, max(l) FILTER(Cancer='Lung AC') lu_l, max(p) FILTER(Cancer='Lung AC') lu_p, max(l) FILTER(Cancer='Ovary SC') ov_l, max(p) FILTER(Cancer='Ovary SC') ov_p FROM x GROUP BY Gene), u AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE isfinite(co_l) AND isfinite(co_p) AND isfinite(lu_l) AND isfinite(lu_p) AND isfinite(ov_l) AND isfinite(ov_p)) SELECT COUNT(*) common_universe, SUM(CASE WHEN co_p<.01 AND abs(co_l)>=.5 AND co_l>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) colon_up, SUM(CASE WHEN co_p<.01 AND abs(co_l)>=.5 AND co_l<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) colon_down, SUM(CASE WHEN lu_p<.01 AND abs(lu_l)>=.5 AND lu_l>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lung_up, SUM(CASE WHEN lu_p<.01 AND abs(lu_l)>=.5 AND lu_l<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lung_down, SUM(CASE WHEN ov_p<.01 AND abs(ov_l)>=.5 AND ov_l>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ovary_up, SUM(CASE WHEN ov_p<.01 AND abs(ov_l)>=.5 AND ov_l<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ovary_down FROM u"}

turns.text:
## Differential-expression universe and counts

Using **Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table**, there are **6,297** genes with finite logFC and adjusted *p* values in **all three** CPTAC comparisons. Differential expression was defined as adjusted *p* < 0.01 and |logFC| ≥ 0.5.

### Direction-count table and bars

| Cancer | Upregulated | Downregulated |
|---|---:|---:|
| Colon AC | 395 | 774 |
| Lung AC | 501 | 593 |
| Ovary SC | 410 | 330 |

```text
Direction-count bars (each █ ≈ 25 genes)

Colon AC  Up    395 | ████████████████
          Down  774 | ███████████████████████████████

Lung AC   Up    501 | ████████████████████
          Down  593 | ████████████████████████

Ovary SC  Up    410 | ████████████████
          Down  330 | █████████████
```

## Upregulated-set Jaccard similarities

|  | Colon AC | Lung AC | Ovary SC |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Colon AC** | 1.000000 | 0.210811 | 0.090786 |
| **Lung AC** | 0.210811 | 1.000000 | 0.098914 |
| **Ovary SC** | 0.090786 | 0.098914 | 1.000000 |

The underlying upregulated-set intersections/unions were:

| Pair | Intersection | Union | Jaccard |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Colon AC–Lung AC | 156 | 740 | 0.210811 |
| Colon AC–Ovary SC | 67 | 738 | 0.090786 |
| Lung AC–Ovary SC | 82 | 829 | 0.098914 |

### Jaccard heatmap

```text
                 Colon AC       Lung AC       Ovary SC
Colon AC         █████ 1.000    █░░░░ 0.211   ░░░░░ 0.091
Lung AC          █░░░░ 0.211    █████ 1.000   ░░░░░ 0.099
Ovary SC         ░░░░░ 0.091    ░░░░░ 0.099   █████ 1.000
```

Using **Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table**, there are **6,297** genes with finite logFC and adjusted *p* values in **all three** CPTAC comparisons. Differential expression was defined as adjusted *p* < 0.01 and |logFC| ≥ 0.5.
